name: Mobileye
sub: L2+/L3 consumer ADAS stacks; Compute / SoC / AI chips; Cameras & vision sensors
regions: Global OEM programs; Israel, Europe, China and US
leadership: Amnon Shashua, President and CEO, announced on 23 July 2026 that he will step aside once a successor is named and has been offered the chairmanship; Intel remains the controlling shareholder
about: Intel-controlled public company and major supplier of EyeQ compute, SuperVision / Chauffeur ADAS and autonomy software. They sit between component supplier and automated-driving stack provider.
model: Sells chips, software stacks, mapping and full driving-assistance systems to automakers.
opMaturity: Commercial-scaled in ADAS; R&D / pilots for higher automation
deployment: Tens of millions of vehicles historically with EyeQ; SuperVision and VW L2+ programs expand richer stacks
metrics: Reuters reported Mobileye plans US robotaxi service in 2027 and Lyft plans Mobileye-powered Dallas AVs.
signal: Mobileye is a hybrid Tier-1, autonomy supplier and emerging operator, creating channel conflict but also a route to scale.

sources.title: Mobileye CEO Amnon Shashua to step aside as company pushes into robotaxis, robotics
